create_graph_with_nodes_and_arcs: create a gtn Graph with start and accept nodes connected by labeled arcs with weights
set_and_get_graph_weights: set graph arc weights using a list or numpy array and retrieve them as a list or numpy array
create_scalar_graph: create a scalar graph from a single weight value using gtn.scalar_graph for differentiable operations
run_backward_autograd: run backward autograd on a graph operation result to compute gradients with optional retain_graph
test_parallel_graph_operations: test parallel graph operations like add, negate, and concat across lists of graphs using gtn.parallel_for
